target: At each fit decision on each scheduled portfolio path, fork four actions from the same state; next-decision marked net NAV minus the explicit hold branch, bp of common opening NAV. No forced liquidation.
features: Causal market features and missing indicators, observed face value by tenor, and lagged cash divided by notional. Exclude prior proposal. Training calibration only.
controls: Market-only Ridge on identical labels; zero tilt; explicit continuous hold; best continuously executed fixed action chosen on the purged fit segment at 2 lots. Hold wins prediction ties.
development_gate: At 2 lot the three-fold median gain against each control must be positive; at 1 lot each must be nonnegative. Already examined internal periods are development only.
confirmation: Only after passing development, evaluate frozen fold-21 models and fixed control once on the first 12 complete grid intervals at or after the registered date. Apply the same per-control sign requirements at 2 and 1 lot. No refitting. A pass warrants further research; no automatic PPO launch.
